text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
—Then, for next event, shall we...
go with this...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes, seems solid landing point...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wondered how it would turn out at one point...
Relieved proposal made tomorrow's deadline.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Hello-san
coming up with compromise!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
No no! Wanted to prioritize
all student opinions, but...
Fell short, sorry~...!

—Few hours after hearing that conversation during day.
Finished work, walking outside for dinner when...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, good work today!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, saw something...
a bit concerning...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Still want to do it...!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Can't we pull off this staging somehow~!
Costs money, but absolutely should do it~...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san.
Tazuna-san...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Thought proposal
was settled at noon, but...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Well... noon version
was just quick compromise!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If we can do our very best,
want to push it all way through!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, wouldn't you
do utmost for your horse girl?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Exhaust every method, use connections...
make absolute best happen, right?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Right? This project is my charge!!
choice_data_list: Then we must do our utmost!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hold on.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Empathizing is fine, but
don't go overdoing it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Stopping reckless overwork is my job.
Cannot overlook this.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh. Won't cause trouble, promise...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: No! Overworking itself is problem.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...So, I will stay with you.
Let's refine until satisfied without overworking♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu.
Come, let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: First, moving stage cut from noon plan...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Works without it, but... memorable climax
becomes subdued.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Above all, want to grant
students' wish to get closer to fans!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So thought about modifying other elements!
Cut equipment rentals as much as possible,
use those funds...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Can't cut lift-up here, so less noticeable staging... Ugh.
Excuse me, another iced coffee please...
choice_data_list: Let me refill your drink bar cup.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Rather... shop closing soon.
Let's move locations!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no ideas coming!
Just need a little more!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Nowhere left to make major changes...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Can't tweak, no extra budget...
Hmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, would be great if possible, but...—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Manpower.
Wait, if horse girls do it—!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Moving whole stage is massive.
But moving in small groups with bicycle-like carts!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...! If it's an umamusume,
the performer herself could pedal a bicycle
carrying multiple passengers!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
She can get close to the audience, and it'd look
super cute visually too! Plus it cuts budget,
and if we can just secure traffic flow at the venue—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I-It's doooone~~!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
Thanks to you, we made great use of the students' idea!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, turned out even better than the daytime plan, didn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, we did push ourselves quite a bit.
So—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...a reward is in order, I believe♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... hits the spot!
Nothing beats ramen after work... so comforting...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Especially after working so hard♪
choice_data_list: This kind of reward could get addictive...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Next time, instead of late-night ramen,
shall we plan our reward more carefully?♪
choice_data_list: Going unplanned has its own addictive charm...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a reward!
Where shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
In that case...!
I'll look up some places!
We absolutely have to go!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now.
...Fufu, oh you.
